Logen.io | Founding Full-stack / AI Engineer | Bengaluru, India | REMOTE | Full-time / Contract

Logen.io is building an AI app builder for real production apps — not just toy prototypes. The goal is to let users go from idea → working web app → deployable product, with auth, database, payments, custom domains, and editable app structure built in.

We’re looking for a founding engineer who can own core product and infra areas end-to-end.

You’ll work on: - AI app generation and iterative editing - Preview/deploy infrastructure - Generated app architecture and templates - Auth, DB, payments, storage, and custom domains - Making AI-built apps reliable, debuggable, and maintainable

You should be: - Strong at full-stack product engineering - Comfortable working with LLMs / AI coding tools - Able to make product + engineering tradeoffs independently - Interested in building developer tools / app-builder infrastructure - Fast, pragmatic, and allergic to unnecessary process

Bonus points for Elixir/Phoenix, React, deployment infra, codegen systems, or previous early-stage startup experience.

Email: shvilesh@logen.io Site: https://logen.io
